Never edit `.stscene`, `.stmat`, `.stproj`, `.meta` by hand; move/rename/delete through the editor
Only public members registered with `ST_SCRIPT_FIELD` survive hot reload
Read presses in `OnUpdate`, apply forces in `OnFixedUpdate`
Teleport with `Teleport`, not by writing a transform
Never keep `GetScript<T>()` pointers across frames; store `Entity` and check `IsValid()`
Never block or start threads in scripts
One of RigidBody or CharacterController, never both
Triggers do not see triangle-mesh colliders
Spawn bodies apart; `Instantiate` with a translation sets scale 1
Collision layers are the project's, not the scene's
A scene with no light is unlit in the game even though editor captures show preview lighting
Automatic exposure brightens dark scenes to gray
Do not build HUDs from screen-space `Text`; use a UI canvas
Pruned exports drop assets loaded by path; list them in Export > Always Include
Export refuses while a build runs, the module changed since load, or scripts are unbuilt
Keep worlds within 20 km; roaming things in the persistent scene
Deterministic play-tests: seeds, fixed-step input durations, `input.sequence`, paused `until` waits
Asset licenses: CC0 or CC-BY only, credited
In a toggle group act only on value 1
Rebuilding the engine while an editor runs fails
`ST_SCRIPT_CLASS` once per class, in a `.cpp`, never in a header
Shared libraries a module links must sit next to it / RUNPATH; `$ORIGIN` fails under hot reload
